findings.defect: A footstep sounds like a horse’s hoofbeat in an indoor scene.
findings.rationale: The sound marks the Emperor’s footstep as he stops.

findings.current: He had gone to the finest physician beneath Heaven and returned, bearing hope that shone brighter than ever.
findings.defect: Jin is made to return with the hope himself.
findings.rationale: Jin sends the physician back to the Emperor; Jin has already departed.
findings.replacement: He had given the finest physician beneath Heaven a hope that shone brighter than ever and sent him back.
findings.source: 천하에서 가장 뛰어난 의원에게, 그 어느 때보다도 환하게 빛나는 희망을 건네어 돌려보냈다.

findings.current: If the imperial physicians found even the slightest problem with his health, they might have to prepare for death themselves.
findings.defect: Finding a health problem is substituted for the Emperor developing one, changing why the physician fears the consequences.
findings.rationale: The source makes an adverse change in the Emperor’s health—not its detection—the danger to his physicians.
findings.replacement: If anything at all went wrong with the Emperor’s health, the imperial physicians might have to prepare for death themselves.
findings.source: 황실의 어의(御醫)들은 황제의 건강에 조금이라도 이상이 생긴다면 죽음까지 각오해야 할 정도였으니까.

findings.current: Light returned to his sunken eyes,
findings.defect: “Sunken” suggests physically hollow eyes rather than a subdued gaze.
findings.rationale: The contrast is between the Emperor’s earlier dejection and his renewed hope.
findings.replacement: A light appeared in his once-subdued eyes,

findings.current: Not one of them slowed for even a moment,
findings.defect: “Slowed” strengthens the claim: the source says the horses never stopped.
findings.rationale: 발을 멈추지 않았고 describes not halting, not maintaining an unchanging speed.
findings.replacement: Not one of them stopped for even a moment,
findings.source: 한혈마(汗血馬)의 피를 이어받았다는 준마는 그 명성답게 단 한 순간도 발을 멈추지 않았고

summary: One action is reversed, and several smaller details alter the scene’s mechanics or imagery.
